# statuspal-next_containers (Data Source)

Lists the containers (regions) on a status page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statuspal-next_containers" "acme" {
  status_page_subdomain = "acme-status"
}

output "container_names" {
  value = [for c in data.statuspal-next_containers.acme.containers : c.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `status_page_subdomain` (String) Subdomain of the status page whose containers to list.

### Read-Only

- `containers` (Attributes List) Containers on the status page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--containers))
